improved: Question navigator circles show green for correct, red for incorrect and orange for flagged answers in Tests and Exams.
A colour key and current-question outline keep navigation clear; unmarked written answers stay neutral.

releases.title: Clear objective feedback in Tests and Exams

new: Tests and Exams show green Correct and red Incorrect feedback for saved objective answers, with a colour legend.
improved: Theory answers clearly remain for teacher marking.

releases.title: Mission pictures and stable test pages

new: Teachers can add optional pictures to Q5, Q8, Assessment A/B, Theory and Essay missions.
Students can enlarge mission pictures and read accessible descriptions.
improved: Pictures are retained when saving, reopening, reusing and exporting mission drafts.
fixed: Fixed test pictures blinking and shifting answers during countdown and heartbeat updates.

releases.title: Keep picture descriptions when replacing images

fixed: Replacing a question picture keeps its existing accessible description.

new: Teachers can add code screenshots and pictures to Test and Exam questions.
Students can enlarge question pictures without leaving their test.
improved: Teachers can update pictures on published papers while preserving saved answers.

releases.title: Keep reinstated tests available when learners return

improved: Teacher-reinstated tests and exams remain available on later days while published.
fixed: Removed the midnight access expiry for reinstated papers and clarified the teacher confirmation.

releases.title: Reliable test starts and teacher-controlled recovery

new: Teachers can reinstate or resume published tests and exams while preserving saved answers and completed result history.
improved: Reinstated papers are available on the recovery day, with timed sittings starting a fresh timer when the learner returns.
fixed: Fixed validation that prevented new test and exam attempts from starting.
Corrected page-departure event names and reduced duplicate warnings from one departure.

new: Teachers can browse draft and published Tests and Exams by subject and status, view saved questions and marking notes, and open a paper for review and publishing.
improved: Saved paper lists clearly label draft and published papers.
fixed: Release verification accepts only the approved exact Netlify hosting comment on deploy URLs while keeping canonical artifacts byte-exact.

releases.title: Student result filters and Year 8 selection

new: Filter Student Results by task focus and activity type, including Assessment A and Assessment B.
improved: Combine subject, date, criterion and type filters in teacher and management result views; downloads follow the selection.
fixed: Include Year 8 in student picker filters.

releases.title: Cup Pong presentation, music and smoother controls

new: Added background music and separate Music and Sound FX settings for Pong.
improved: Pong now has a dark court, clearer player colours, compact controls and a layout that fits the screen.
Completed computer levels offer a direct Next Level action.
fixed: Fixed local paddle jumps when pressing, releasing or reversing controls.
Smoothed ball and opponent rendering during uneven network updates.

new: Populate Objective, Theory, Essay Builder and assessments by pasting structured text.
improved: Review recognised fields and repair missing content before applying it to a draft.
fixed: Empty import headings no longer swallow the next field, and Essay teaching text stays separate from sentence sections.

releases.title: Pong pacing, collisions, and online responsiveness

improved: Pong starts faster and ramps through the 15 levels; rallies and moving-paddle strikes add controlled pace within the server speed cap.
Local paddle and Forward Rush motion respond immediately while authoritative multiplayer frames render with eased interpolation and correction.
fixed: Swept paddle contacts and stable obstacle normals reduce high-speed misses, sticking, and repeated contact.

new: Play Pong on a vertical court with yourself always defending from the bottom, including in student battles.
Collect seven temporary boosts, use Forward Rush, and choose Power Battle for explicitly accepted student matches.
improved: Paddle movement and impact position now shape capped ball speed, angle and spin, with motion-aware visual effects and optional sound.
The deterministic computer opponent can collect boosts and adapt within each level's limits.

new: Play Pong against the computer across 15 levels with saved progress and replay.
Invite an available student in your school to a fair first-to-seven Pong battle.
Teachers and management can enable games, computer play and student battles for each learner.
improved: Pong supports keyboard, drag and touch controls, with calm visuals and reduced motion.
Games pause on connection loss and preserve saved progress when access changes.

fixed: Made release-note headings easier to read.

new: Open the version button to see what changed and browse previous releases.
A New indicator highlights updates you have not viewed yet.
improved: Production updates now receive a consistent version and release notes before publication.
fixed: Fixed an issue that could prevent teachers from creating missions after uploading lesson material.
Existing accounts keep their school context when signing in or restoring a session.

improved: Learning missions, results and school progress tools.
